<body>

<quoted>
---------------------- Forwarded by Jay Nolan on 11/11/2024 10:32 AM ---------------------------

   Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd.
   
   From:  Flag Football Challenge @ Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd.                           21/10/2024 22:38

Sent by: KestrelAnnouncements@kestrelaero.co.uk
To: Flag Football Invite
cc: 
Subject: Kestrel/Strato Flag Football Invitation

Kestrel Aerospace and Strato Systems are proud to sponsor the 2nd Annual Falcon-Eagle Flag Football Challenge on Saturday, November 16. The event aims to raise funds for both organisations and celebrate the long-standing rivalry in collegiate football. This marks the 107th meeting between Kestrel Falcons and Strato Eagles, with the Big 12 South Title potentially at stake!

Kestrel and Strato Systems are sponsoring the event, but we need your support as players and fundraisers. Proceeds will benefit the general scholarship funds of the two schools.

The details:
Date:    Saturday, November 16th

Time:    10:00 a.m. - approximately 4 p.m. (Warm up at 9:30 a.m.)

Location:   Eagle Sports Complex (just off Avonmouth Road, south of M32)

Food and Drinks:  Beckett’s BBQ (FREE - courtesy of Kestrel Aerospace)

Eligibility:   Full-time employees and/or their spouses  
(Players must have graduated from Falcon University or Strato College)

Team Jerseys:  Provided by Kestrel and Strato Systems

Format:   7 players with at least 1 female player on the field at all times

Team Size: Recommend 8-10 players per team (maximum 10 per team) Contact team captains to sign up. (Sign up now to secure your place)

Prizes:    Winning team gets 16 tickets to the Kestrel/Strato game in Bristol on Friday, November 22. Winners also hold the “Skyhawk Cup” trophy until next year!

Fundraising Goal: The committee aims to raise £16,000 for each school. This requires £2,000 contribution per team plus matching corporate funds.

Last year’s event saw a last-minute comeback as AeroTech 1 defeated the Kestrel Falcons Team 1 for the championship and trophy. This year, expect the Falcons (and Strato) to be out for revenge!

Thanks to a generous gift from the Strato Alumni, who redirected their donations to the Kestrel Foundation, we permanently endowed scholarships in memory of the 12 Falcons lost in last year’s Horizon crash. We believe this event is an important tradition for both companies and are proud to raise vital funds for both institutions.
</quoted>
